# 판정: (A) 학습·이해용 — Lemma 4 (Pushforward density) 증명 노트
---

$\Delta_1\varrho := (\varrho_2-\varrho_1,\ldots,\varrho_n-\varrho_1)$은 HST 초기 설정에서 **상대 높이 벡터**다.
절대 높이 $\varrho_i$는 시간이 지날수록 무한히 커지지만, 상대 높이는 bounded region에 머문다.
Lemma 4는 이 벡터의 pushforward density가 특정 영역 안에서 아래로 균일하게 bound됨을 보인다.

**Lemma 4 (Pushforward density).** Let $\varrho_1,\ldots,\varrho_n\overset{\text{iid}}{\sim}\text{Unif}(0,b)$ and $\Delta_1\varrho:=(\varrho_2-\varrho_1,\ldots,\varrho_n-\varrho_1)\in\mathbb{R}^{n-1}$. The density $f_{\text{pdf}}$ of $\Delta_1\varrho$ satisfies
$$f_{\text{pdf}}(\delta\varrho)\;\geq\;\frac{b^{1-n}}{2}\qquad\text{whenever }\|\delta\varrho\|_\infty<\frac{b}{4}.$$

**Proof.** We use two claims.

**Claim 1.** $f_{\text{pdf}}(\delta\varrho)=b^{-n}\,\ell(\delta\varrho)$, where $\ell(\delta\varrho):=\bigl|[0,b]\cap\bigcap_{i=1}^{n-1}[-\delta\varrho_i,\,b-\delta\varrho_i]\bigr|$.

**Claim 2.** $\|\delta\varrho\|_\infty<b/4\;\Rightarrow\;\ell(\delta\varrho)>b/2$.

Assuming the claims,
$$f_{\text{pdf}}(\delta\varrho)=b^{-n}\,\ell(\delta\varrho)>b^{-n}\cdot\frac{b}{2}=\frac{b^{1-n}}{2}.$$
It remains to prove the claims.

---

**Proof of Claim 1.** The map $\varrho\mapsto(\varrho_1,\,\Delta_1\varrho)$ is lower-triangular with Jacobian $1$, so the joint density of $(\varrho_1,\delta\varrho)$ is $b^{-n}\cdot\mathbf{1}[\varrho\in[0,b]^n]$. The inverse gives $\varrho_{i+1}=\varrho_1+\delta\varrho_i$, so
$$\varrho\in[0,b]^n\;\Leftrightarrow\;\varrho_1\in[0,b]\,\cap\,\bigcap_{i=1}^{n-1}[-\delta\varrho_i,\,b-\delta\varrho_i]\;=:\;\mathcal{I}(\delta\varrho).$$
Marginalizing over $\varrho_1$:
$$f_{\text{pdf}}(\delta\varrho)=\int_\mathbb{R}b^{-n}\,\mathbf{1}[\varrho_1\in\mathcal{I}(\delta\varrho)]\,d\varrho_1=b^{-n}\,\ell(\delta\varrho).$$

**Proof of Claim 2.** Write $\mathcal{I}(\delta\varrho)=[c^-,\,c^+]$ where
$$c^+=b-\max(0,\,\max_i\,\delta\varrho_i),\qquad c^-=\max(0,\,-\min_i\,\delta\varrho_i).$$
Under $\|\delta\varrho\|_\infty<b/4$:
$$\max_i\,\delta\varrho_i<\frac{b}{4}\;\Rightarrow\;c^+>\frac{3b}{4},\qquad -\min_i\,\delta\varrho_i<\frac{b}{4}\;\Rightarrow\;c^-<\frac{b}{4}.$$
Therefore $\ell(\delta\varrho)=c^+-c^->b/2$. $\square$

---

**해설.** 핵심 아이디어는 $\varrho\mapsto(\varrho_1,\Delta_1\varrho)$로 좌표를 바꾸면 $\varrho_1$ 하나에만 적분이 남는다는 것이다. $b/4$ 조건은 $n$개의 uniform 구간 $[0,b]$, $[-\delta\varrho_i,\,b-\delta\varrho_i]$의 공통 부분이 길이 $b/2$ 이상임을 보장한다. $n$이 커질수록 하한 $b^{1-n}/2$은 작아지지만, 영역 $\|\delta\varrho\|_\infty<b/4$ 안에서 density가 **uniformly positive**하다는 성질은 보존된다.
